WITH counted AS (
  SELECT 
    projects.fundflux,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM scanqc
  INNER JOIN projects ON scanqc.arcref = projects.arcregistry
  GROUP BY projects.fundflux
)
SELECT 
  fundflux,
  count,
  count * 1.0 / SUM(count) OVER () as fraction,
  count * 1.0 * COUNT(*) OVER () / SUM(count) OVER () as count_over_avg
FROM counted
ORDER BY fundflux NULLS LAST
